name: Shenzhen Rapoo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Rapoo Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, designs, manufactures, and sells consumer electronics worldwide. The company offers wired and wireless mice and keyboards; combo sets; and gaming products, such as mice, keyboards, headsets and audio, combos, gamepads and controllers, and gaming accessories and gears. It also provides video conference camera, webcam, presentation pointers, speaker phones, USB hubs, earbuds, and laptop cooling pads and holders. It offers its products under the Rapoo brand. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
